description: This file defines a ViewModel called NotesListViewModel used in an Android app to manage UI state for a list of notes. It interacts with a repository to observe notes and sync status, handles query filtering, and provides functions for manual sync actions.

classes.name: NotesListUiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state for the notes list, including the search query, list of notes, and synchronization status.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel that manages the state and actions for a list of notes, including querying, observing data, and triggering manual syncs.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query in the flow, which triggers UI to update the displayed list of notes.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Initiates a manual sync operation by enqueuing a background job and attempting immediate sync, providing user feedback on sync status.
